references.text: The same construction principle is used for the ark of the covenant, where rings are placed at the feet to carry it with poles.
The incense altar also has rings and poles for transport, following the same pattern as the table.
Describes the actual execution of the rings and poles for the table, fulfilling the instructions given here.
The bronze altar also has poles for transport that are inserted into rings, using the same carrying system.
The Levites' task to carry the table with its poles during the journey in the wilderness.
Describes the same event (the construction of the table) from an instructional to an execution perspective.
The direct description of the execution confirming that the instruction regarding the carrying poles was followed exactly.
